messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Assalam o Alaikum, Raast payment agent. Aap ko government ki relief wali 12,000 rupay milegi.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Kis scheme ki baat kar rahe hain?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ehsaas program. Bas pehle 500 registration fee bhejo, phir 12 hazar foran aayenge.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Fee kyun? Relief to free hoti hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Madam system mein fee ke baghair entry nahi hoti. Aaj last day hai, jaldi karo.
